title: Claude Code scheduled tasks — turning prompts into a 24/7 agent employee

title: Concise outputs beat verbosity — study behind the caveman prompting trend
summary: A study of 31 open-weight models on 1,500 problems found small models beat much larger ones on ~8% of problems, but forcing the big models to be concise reversed it. Ties into the caveman repo that makes Claude Code talk tersely; the claim is brevity improves accuracy, not just token cost, possibly undoing RLHF-learned over-explaining.
takeaways: Instructing concise answers can raise accuracy on large models.
Verbose reasoning can talk a model into wrong answers.
Caveman-style output rules also cut tokens.

title: Programmatic SEO in an hour a week — answer real questions with ChatGPT
summary: A claimed $40K/month of organic traffic (14K visitors, 708 keywords) from a simple loop: find a question on findquestions.com, draft an answer with ChatGPT, edit, add images and three internal links, publish weekly.
takeaways: Target real user questions, one post per week.
Always add internal links and human edits to AI drafts.

takeaways: Put design rules in CLAUDE.md so every page follows them.
